verdict.rationale: The live machine-readable pricing page states 2FAS Auth ships with 'no advertising, no telemetry', so there is no usage tracking to opt out of. 2FAS Pass is described as '100% anonymous use' with no registration, which supports the same privacy posture. Missing for 10: an explicit no-telemetry statement for 2FAS Pass and the browser extensions, a detailed privacy or telemetry policy doc, and independent or hands-on verification (e.g., a network-traffic audit) that no tracking occurs.
